hypotheses.justification: The statement elaborates without this instance: H1, LevelLE and the definition wL do not require it. Split on N = 0; the nonzero case uses the existing proof. At N = 0, iDeg' with parameter 1 is the identity, and direct matrix calculation gives iotaDeg_q ∘ conjL equal to subgroup inclusion. The source lemmas heckeT_card_smul_impl and IharaMintIdx.natCard_rightQuot in S_CohCarrier_heckeT_iDeg_q_eq_smul.lean require no nonzero level and give heckeT ∘ iDeg'_q = q • id (since q ∣ 0). Unfolding wL therefore reduces the conclusion to q • heckeT v - q • heckeT v = 0. This also works for the trivial coefficient ring; [NeZero q] remains available.
